label: measured

tiers.default: factory defaults: codata constants, automatic cutoff and bands, sparsity off

conditions.reference: VASP 6.4.1 (version string read from each vasprun.xml)
conditions.paw: same PBE.54 PAW datasets on both sides (titles per system below)
conditions.kpoints: same Gamma-centred full mesh on both sides, ISYM=-1
conditions.bands: same NBANDS in SCF; VASP NSCF solves max(2n, n+8) and the window keeps n minus the top 2
conditions.geometry: nominal geometry, not relaxed; random displacement and strain excite forces and stress

gaas_vasp_ediff.note: same INCAR except EDIFF, same explicit k path; PROCAR prints three decimals; the comparison window uses the lowest 6 of 8 Sparse-DFT bands

note: Status counts SCF checks only (energy, forces, stress, eigenvalues, electrons, DOS, moment); band-path and projection checks are reported in their own columns.
